# Evidence for globex-staff-platform

Every generated bullet or paragraph must cite from this pool. The model re-frames; it does not invent.

## Project receipts

- Billing migration: monolith to event-driven services, invoice generation ~40s to under 2s.
- Regional rollout: US, EU, APAC, zero customer-visible downtime.
- On-call: idempotency keys plus a dead-letter replay tool cut paging volume 60%.
- Internal platform: service template and CI pipeline adopted by 9 teams, two-day setup to under an hour.
- Cost: billing infrastructure spend reduced 35% via right-sizing and spot capacity for batch reconciliation.
- Kubernetes appears only in the context of the service template, not as deep operational ownership.
